options.name: Short-Film Packing Room
options.case_for: Best for the corrected deck: each slide is a lived packing-room action, both partners are guilty, and the zip becomes the harmless villain.
options.risk: Must keep the couple's bodies, faces, teamwork, and blame visible so the suitcase does not become the lead character.

options.name: Split-Screen Evidence Board
options.case_for: Quickly contrasts her outfit options with his tech pile.
options.risk: Rejected as the main system because it becomes label-heavy and object-first.

options.name: Suitcase As Relocated House
options.risk: Rejected because a surreal suitcase-house can overpower Aachu/Zuv and turn the story into clever prop art.
